findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: The test strips that were available at the facility were the incorrect strips for testing sanitizer concentrations. The strips were for testing pH levels. Demonstrated how to properly test sanitizer solutions with the PIC. Ensure that quaternary ammonia test strips are available to properly test sanitizer concentrations. Will follow-up on 1/6/2025 to ensure that test strips are available.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

(REPEAT) Observed the hand sink blocked by a pitcher. Cease practice. Hand sinks should remain free during all operational hours. Hnad sinks must be accessible to employees. Discussed with PIC and owner over the phone. Ensure staff is aware. Repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 11/1/21.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Observed the pizza grates of the pizza ovens to be heavily soiled with burnt food debris. The trays were clean. Ensure staff is aware to clean both the trays and the grates routinely to prevent food debris build-up. Discussed with owner over the phone and PIC. PIC began to wash, rinse, and sanitize during the inspection. COS.

findings.citation_text: 6-201.11  (C) Observed the metal box in the walk in cooler to be peeling. Ensure the metal box is smoothed out to make it smooth and easily cleanable. Reference 6-201.11.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Freezer door taped shut using duct tape.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
Walk in cooler does not have adequate lighting.
750-1230(b)(2) Permanently fixed artificial light sources shall be installed to provide, at a distance of 30 inches from the floor at least 10 foot-candles of light in walk-in refrigeration, dry storage areas, and in all other areas.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed the ice bin to be in the open position when not actively in use. Keep ice bin covered when not in use.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1) Observed the counter underneath the pizza oven to be in disrepair with grooves from appearing to be used as a cutting board. Repair counter so that it is smooth, non absorbent and easily cleanable. 2) Observed the seal on the walk in cooler door to be broken. Replace seal.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed the sanitizer in the spray bottle to be testing in excess of 200 ppm Chlorine. Sanitizer in spray bottle should be at a 100 ppm concentration when using bleach.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed a pizza cutter with food debris sitting on the counter next to the pizza oven. Wash, rinse and sanitize pizza cutter and store clean and dry. 2) Observed the microwave to be soiled with food splash on all interior surfaces. Clean and sanitize the microwave.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
REPEAT> 1) Observed the caulk at the sink in the women's restroom to be cracked and separating from the wall. Recaulk hand sink to the wall. 2) The threshold leading into the walk in cooler is unsealed wood on all sides. Seal wood to provide a smooth, nonabsorbent, easily cleanable surface as the bottom threshold is starting to show signs of possible mold.
750-1210(b) Walls and ceilings in walk-in refrigeration units, food preparation areas, equipment washing areas, and toilet rooms shall be smooth, light-cored, non-absorbant, and easily cleanable. Concrete or pumice block in these locations shall be finished and sealed to provide a cleanable surface.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed the ice bin to be in the open position. Ice bin was closed during inspection. Maintain ice bin in the closed position to protect from potential contamination.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed the caulk at the sink in the women's restroom to be cracked. Re-seal sink to the wall. 2) The threshold leading into the walk in cooler is unsealed wood. Seal wood to provide surfaces to be smooth, non absorbent and easily cleanable.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.
